QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_49

question.text: Stakeholders in a Social Impact Assessment, per Section 5.7.1, include ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Risk investors, impact investors, outcome funders
The SIA's personal family members (unless formally engaged)

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.7.1 lists the SIA's stakeholders as: Social Enterprise (FPE/NPO), Beneficiaries, Risk Investors, Impact Investors, Outcome Funder, Third Party Evaluator, Intermediaries, Regulators, Society/communities, Vendors, Third-party agencies, Governments, Fund providers, Trustees, Directors, Corporates. The SIA's own family members are not stakeholders of the SE and their inclusion would actually raise independence concerns. The Trap: A, B, C are all explicitly listed. D is the clearly excluded item — and any attempt to formally include family members would trigger independence/CoC violations. Cross-Exam Context: Stakeholder taxonomy unique to XXIII; related stakeholder-mapping concepts appear in NISM XV (RA) for investor communication. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Map stakeholders into four rings (decision-makers, implementers, beneficiaries, observers) early in planning — this visual mapping prevents accidental omission of a material stakeholder group like vendors or third-party agencies.
